nom: Clinique Clinique For Men Oil Control Exfoliating Tonic

avis.titre: I ordered a new product, but it feels like I received a used
avis.texte: This product was sold as new, but the condition I received it in suggests otherwise. The surface had sticky residue, as if glue had been left on it, and there was no protective sticker or seal inside. It honestly felt like I received a second-hand item. I'm extremely disappointed with the quality control and would not consider this acceptable for a new product.
I got this tonic for my brother and his acne started clearing up in the first week. His skin has always been oily and acne prone. This tonic really exfoliated his face and is keeping oil levels low.

Purchased this for my husband who had begun his skin care journey. I went for Clinique since it's pretty reputable. It took about a week or two to notice changes in his skin. At first it dried out some of his skin like on his cheeks, but he switched to adding less on his cotton ball before application and his skin reacted much better. It's helped with his very oily skin. My only wish is that I could find this for very sensitive skin.
I surprised my boyfriend with this. He was skeptical at first but now believes it's amazing. Made a huge difference in a short amount of time.

This product works fairly well but in my experience it doesn't stop the oil. It just slows down the oil production in my T-zone. When I don't use it I can tell a big difference. I also use the Oil Control face wash and the facial scrub (both by Clinique for men). I still get oily overall but less oily than when I don't use the product.
I have used this product for years. I was disappointed when Clinque changed their formula from different skin types to one all inclusive product. It is still a good product and I will still use it.
Skin feels clean afterwards. Not too strong like some cheap products.
I use it for cleaning my neck to prevent collar stains on my dress shirts
Keeps my skin toned, healthy looking. Been using it for decades, first as Clarifying Lotion (same thing). No exotic ingredients but it is best out there.

avis.titre: Scruffing Lotion - A must buy for men!
avis.texte: I bought this product for my husband and he loves it! He works in a plant and the chemicals from the items he handles causes his skin to have dry patches. Since using the scruffing lotion, along with the other Clinique 3 step cleansers, he and I both have noticed a tremendous difference.

avis.titre: My husband immediately noticed a change!
avis.texte: Great product to use to soften skin for men, immediately noticed a difference in ability to shave easily.
